intent: Connector result card for a completed GitHub tool call: a GitHub header, the tool name marked done with a brand-colored success check, and an optional result summary below.
guidance: Render this once a GitHub tool call has completed; the brand CircleCheck (c-text-brand) is fixed, so the card only depicts success — pass GitHubPermissionCard for the pending decision, and a different surface for errors. The trailing chevron is decorative: the card wires no onClick, aria-expanded, or expand/collapse, so control the summary yourself by passing or omitting children. toolName sits on one truncating line — keep it the raw function name (e.g. get_me). The GitHub mark is lucide Github, never a raster octocat. It renders a plain div with no role, so add role="group" and an accessible name at the host layer if it must be announced.

anatomy.description: Github glyph (c-icon) + "GitHub" label (c-text), divided from the body by a bottom border (c-border).
A brand-colored CircleCheck (c-text-brand) marking the call completed, the truncating tool name (c-text), and a trailing decorative chevron (c-icon).
Optional region below the tool row that renders children (the tool's output); shown only when children are passed.

use_when: Reporting a completed GitHub tool call in the agent thread, after any permission step.
You want a compact connector result with the tool name and an optional output summary.
dont_use_when: The tool call is still awaiting the user's decision — use GitHubPermissionCard.
The call is pending or errored — this card only renders the completed, success state.

slots.children: Optional result summary rendered beneath the tool row (e.g. the tool's output); omit to show just the header + tool row.

tokens.note: Rendered styling binds only c-* tokens and var(--composa-font-family); no #hex literals, so tokensOnly is true. Spacing and sizing are hardcoded: header px 12px / py 8px, tool row px 8px / py 8px, summary px 12px / pb 10px, gap 8px; 24px icon frames with an 18px Github / CircleCheck glyph and a 16px chevron (strokeWidth 1.5).

a11y.role: none rendered — the card, header, and rows are plain <div>s; add role="group" and an accessible name to expose it as a labelled group.
a11y.chevron: decorative only — the card renders no expand/collapse control, button, or aria-expanded, so the chevron toggles and announces nothing.
a11y.icons: Github and CircleCheck are unlabelled decorative glyphs; the check conveys the completed state visually only.
a11y.toolName: truncates on one line (min-w-0 truncate) — expose the full name elsewhere if it may clip.
